title: Final Mean Life
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the mean life of the tau particle as 2.6 x 10^-13 s.

title: Final Flight Length
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the mean flight length of the tau particle as 6.29 x 10^-2 cm.

title: Decay Probability Ratio
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the relationship between the decay probabilities of muon and tau particles using their masses.

title: Branching Ratio Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the branching ratio to find the mean life of the tau particle.

title: Lorentz Factor Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately calculate the Lorentz factor for the tau particle in the laboratory frame.

title: Beta Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the calculation of beta to show the relationship between velocity and speed of light.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the calculations of decay probabilities.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing factors in the decay probability equations.
